content.title: Cubs Announce 2026 Opening Day Roster
content.text: AP Photo/Erin HooleyThe Cubs open the 2026 season tomorrow against the Nationals at Wrigley Field, and now we know exactly who will be there when they do. See the media release below for details.The Chicago Cubs have set their 2026 Opening Day 26-man roster in advance of their 2026 season opener tomorrow vs. the Washington Nationals at Wrigley Field.Infielder Scott Kingery and outfielder Michael Conforto have been selected to the 40-man roster.The Cubs have placed outfielder Seiya Suzuki on the 10-day injured list with a right knee sprain (retroactive to March 22), right-handed pitcher Porter Hodge on the 15-day injured list with a right elbow strain (retroactive to March 22), left-handed pitcher Jordan Wicks on the 15-day injured list with left forearm inflammation (retroactive to March 22) and left-handed pitcher Justin Steele on the 60-day injured list with a left elbow injury.Right-handed pitcher Jack Neely has been designated for assignment.Here is a look at the Cubs 2026 Opening Day roster:Pitchers (13)16 – Matthew Boyd, LHP18 – Shota Imanaga, LHP22 – Cade Horton, RHP24 – Caleb Thielbar, LHP30 – Edward Cabrera, RHP32 – Ben Brown, RHP41 – Hoby Milner, LHP45 – Hunter Harvey, RHP48 – Daniel Palencia, RHP50 – Jameson Taillon, RHP53 – Colin Rea, RHP71 – Jacob Webb, RHP88 – Phil Maton, RHPCatchers (3)9 – Miguel Amaya15 – Carson Kelly25 – Moisés Ballesteros (L)Infielders (6)2 – Nico Hoerner3 – Alex Bregman6 – Matt Shaw7 – Dansby Swanson12 – Scott Kingery29 – Michael Busch (L)Outfielders (4)4 – Pete Crow-Armstrong (L)5 – Dylan Carlson (S)8 – Ian Happ (S)20 – Michael Conforto (L)The coaching staff under manager Craig Counsell (#11) is as follows: Ryan Flaherty (bench, #84), Tommy Hottovy (pitching, #68), Dustin Kelly (hitting, #76), Jose Javier (first base, #65), Quintin Berry (third base, #0), Mark Strittmatter (bullpen, #81), Casey Jacobson (assistant pitching, #86), Juan Cabreja (assistant hitting, #63), John Mallee (assistant hitting, #80), Jonathan Mota (coach, #90), AJ Lewis (staff assistant, #74), Erick Castillo (bullpen catcher, #93) and Garrett Lloyd (bullpen catcher, #85).Now PlayingUp Next138.
